tools.description: Free sample: real output for Marseille (13055) as of 2026-11-11, with two claim windows open. Same shape as catnat_lookup.

tools.name: catnat_lookup
tools.description: Use this when you need to know whether a natural disaster was officially recognized in a French commune and whether a home-insurance claim can still be filed. For 1 to 50 communes (INSEE codes): CatNat decrees with an open claim window and the latest decree (Journal officiel), with peril and event d

findings.title: Tool description changed since last scan
findings.detail: Tool "catnat_lookup" changed its description with no version change. Silent description changes are how a trusted server turns malicious after review.
